title: Opt Mem: Give Your AI Agent Real Memory That Stays Local
description:
Explaining your whole context to an AI agent every single session gets old fast 😅

Victor Taelin released Opt Mem on GitHub, persistent memory for agents. The agent writes down what matter between sessions and pulls it back next time.

Best part: memory sits localy, not tied to any model or service. Swap agents, your knowledge stays ✨

#ai #chatgpt #claude #claudecode #gemini
